text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Invited by the Mejiro family, you were to 
join Mejiro Bright at a gathering held at 
the mansion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a new era where races leaned toward 
favoring pure speed, the Mejiro family 
held exhaustive discussions on what it 
meant to maintain their identity of 
valuing well-rounded strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Bright remained unfazed. 
She was determined to stick to her own way 
as always, and protect the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering the next generation of the 
Mejiros and facing a new era, she set her 
sights on absolute victory in the Tenno 
Sho (Spring).
